batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c LMP Simmons b SL Malinga

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Mandeep Singh b HV Patel

batting.name: KA Pollard
batting.dismissal: c MA Starc b S Aravind

batting.name: HH Pandya
batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b YS Chahal

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b HV Patel

batting.name: Harbhajan Singh
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b MA Starc

batting.name: J Suchith
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b YS Chahal

balls.text: dot ball in the block hole to end the over, blocked back to the bowler
no need to find the gap now, it's gone all the way. Full toss number three of the over, it was on the stumps and he swatted that to the midwicket boundary for a massive six
another full toss, another four, easy peasy! This was outside the off stump, he lofted that with a beautiful drive over the covers in the gap again
full toss on the pads, flicked on the leg side rather easily in the gap, wide of deep backward square leg for four

falls short of midwicket, Rohit has hurt himself too. The full toss was swatted to the leg side, Roihit dived forward and the ball hit his chin after bouncing just before him. The batsmen come back for two meanwhile
in the block hole on middle stump, blocks it down to long on for one
drills that full delivery straight to cover for a quick single
makes room, swings his arms and muscles some power into that inside-out drive over the covers for a one-bounce four
comes down to take it as a full toss and lofts it straight down the ground, long off runs to his right and keeps it to two. Suchith was the fielder
attempted yorker is a low full toss on middle, driven down firmly to long on
full on off, muscled down the ground to long off for one
first makes a lot of room, Malinga chases him down leg, but AB comes back in and it's a big wide. Malinga smiles
no, he can't! Full toss on the stumps, AB moves towards off and goes down on a knee and swats that behind square on the leg side for four
in the block hole just outside off, Kohli comes down and pokes but misses
full toss for Kohli, slammed on the leg side with a slot of power, wide of Pollard again to his right side and he can't stop that either
full on off now, whipped between deep midwicket and long on for one
and again! This was full on the stumps, he muscled that down the ground again, Pollard ran to his left and maybe had a chance but couldn't get there
slower and fuller, AB spots it and slams it straight down the ground for a six now. Gayle gets up in the dressing room and signals the ball to come to him, just missed!
just misses the umpire's head! It was full on the stumps, AB hammered it straight back and the umpire moved away just in time to let the ball go away for four
full toss again, six again, Mumbai clueless again! The ball angled in towards the batsman and he hammered that over the wide long on boundary with a big swing
that's a high full toss near the chest and it's pulled behind square on the leg side. No ball for the height
tries to reverse slap the ball to the off side, but it's full and down the leg side
he's done it - his second IPL hundred with another six. AB shuffles to the off side again down on a knee, and slams it over the midwicket boundary now, same result
full toss towards the leg side, AB goes down on a knee and swats it with the angle by going on the off side, for six over the fine leg boundary
comes down for the full toss and slams it down to long on for one
too full on off and Kohli pounces on that one with a powerful drive drilled through the covers. Big, swivelling follow through to beat everyone
short again, you can't keep bowling short to him. This was on off, he opened up and slammed that with the room he got to send it flying over the covers for a four. Moves into the 90s
angling in towards the stumps, tucked to the leg side for one for his fifty
another short ball, another pull on the leg side and Rayudu slides to his left from deep midwicket to keep it to one

opens up for the bouncer, it's coming almost towards his head and he pulls it square of the wicket in the gap again. Whether he middles the ball or not, he finds the gap for sure every ball. That one lands just inside the rope
short ball angling in, pulled in the gap along the ground between long on and deep midwicket for two
leans towards the ball on off and drives it into the covers
comes down the track for the slower offcutter and Kohli turns it to leg, while taking one hand off it, for one
in the block hole on the stumps, blocks it on the leg side for one
gets a full toss now, no way he's getting away with it as it's slammed down the ground for a one-bounce four
gets a slower one well outside off again, he moves towards it even more and lofts it in the gap over the covers for another four even though long off gives it a chase
shuffles across to the off side by exposing all the stumps and drills that through the covers for a powerful four
length delivery outside off, pushed back towards the bowler for one
slams the fullish ball on the leg side between deep midwicket and long on, Pollard stops it but they take two
digs the block hole out to the leg side and the fielders are way back in the deep to give them time for the second
slow and full on the stumps, AB picks the slower one and swivels his bat to find the gap on the leg side. Rayudu dives in the deep but can't stop despite getting a hand to it
comes down the track and tucks the high full toss to leg for one
tried to slam it on the leg side but got an inside edge towards deep midwicket for one
back of length outside off, swatted down to long on for one
hammers the full delivery into the covers with a cracking drive but Rohit dives to his right to stop that
slightly low full toss on the off stump and AB sweeps that - yes, he's sweeping a fast bowler - to the midwicket boundary from the middle of the bat for four
this full delivery is pushed into the covers for a quick single
in the block hole outside off, taps it to point off the back foot
full toss on the off stump is drilled down the ground towards long on for one
low and slow full toss is tucked to square leg with an edge for one
slow and short outside off, he has enough time to wait for it and then steer it wide of point to place it for four more
charges down and drills the full ball straight down the ground, to beat long on for a cracking four. That's his fifty
takes a step down and pushes the ball to long off for one
bouncer angling in sharply, AB plays an unusual shot by letting in come in very very late and then somehow taps it late to third man, almost from the leg side, for one
taps the short of length ball late to third man for one
length delivery angling in, tucked behind square on the leg side and they come back for the second by the time Malinga runs in
touch flatter towards off stump, tucked to deep midwicket for one
pretty full outside off, driven nicely away from the body to sweeper cover
makes room and then comes back to confuse the bowler, and then sweeps the ball from the middle of the bat to the square leg boundary for four
comes down with some room again and drives that elegantly to long off for one
he comes down again, takes it almost on the full now and lofts it straight down the ground, and well over long on for six
comes down to steer the ball to leg with the angle, but gets an inside edge onto his pads
length delivery on the off stump, driven down to long on for one
he dances down, he doesn't let it spin and he tonks it for six! Picked ip up from middle stump and slogged it to the cow corner boundary for six!
goes back and across in the crease and mistimes the punch down to long off
errs down the leg side for a wide and the keeper misses it too for more byes, counted as wides
turning in from off stump, helped towards deep midwicket for one
makes some room and tucks the ball with slightly soft hands towards deep midwicket for two
comes down the pitch and drives it on the full to long off
on the pads and it's clipped to deep midwicket for one
this is some new shot AB has unleashed - for the second time in the match. Touch back of length outside off and he goes back to loft that over the infield with an inside-out drive
a fumble in the deep on off as AB cuts that square of the wicket and de Lange doesn't collect on first attempt to concede a second
full on the pads and AB flicks it behind square on the leg side. It's placed well enough to just beat Simmons at short fine leg
more towards middle and leg now, turned down to long on off the back foot
length delivery outside off, driven straight to cover off the front foot
dances down and middles that ball to loft it over the wide long-on boundary for six! He took it on the full and didn't let it turn at all
that's timing, that's four! Nothing extravagant, nothing powerful..he drove that gently into the covers and once the ball cleared the fielder in the circle, it raced to the boundary
he comes down too and shows his version of the flick from outside off, for a single to long on
dances down to take it on the full and whips to long on for one
length delivery just outside off, AB reverse-sweeps it to backward deep point for two
turning in towards the stumps from outside off, helped to square leg for one
leans into the ball and tucks it down to long on by beating a diving midwicket
comes down the track and pushes it down to long on for one
lofts that with a drive as he gets room to swing his arms and it falls well short of deep cover
length delivery just outside off, driven down firmly to mid off
drives it outside off and gets a thick outside edge to third man
takes some pace off the ball and delivers it wide outside off, Kohli swishes at it to the deep backward point region and he comes back like a rabbit for the second
goes deep in the crease to pull it over the infield but mistimes it to square leg
now on the other side - comes down the track to take it on the full and merely drives that with sweet timing to go wide of mid on, all along the ground, for four more
slightly slower towards the stumps, AB goes back to make room and lofts it with an inside-out drive to clear the infield for four
pushes the length ball to cover now
goes back in the crease and whips the ball by opening up to deep midwicket
back of length towards the stumps, punched down to long off for one
dabs the length delivery to third man by playing it late
angling in again, tucked to deep square leg for one
charges down the track and hammers that through the covers with a drive from the middle of the bat for four
angling in towards the off stump, pushed back to the bowler
touch outside the off stump, short of length again, he runs it down delicately to third man
back of length and angling towards the batsman, tucked towards deep midwicket for one
bowls this from wide of the crease and delivers a wide down the leg side
back of length outside off, punched to extra cover this time. That's a wicket maiden
further outside the off stumps and swinging away too, steers it to cover point
moving it away again from outside off, defends it into the covers again
fuller outside the off stump, drilled down the ground and mid-off stops it with a dive
doesn't move much and defends the outswinger on the back foot

taken this time, stunner from Simmons! Gayle looked to slap the slower offcutter well outside off and got another thick edge, it was ready to sail over short third man, but Simmons flies to his left and grabs that with both hands. He is thrilled, the team celebrates but not much reaction from the supper staff in the dug out. Jonty Rhodes is not animated at all
leans into the ball a little bit and pushes the length delivery into the covers

dropped by Bhajji at first slip now, what's happening! Kohli came down the track, drove the ball onto the off side and it went straight to Harbhajan, he only had to take it around his shoulders but it popped out straight

dropped by Rohit! That went so high in the air, that probably would have affected Rohit's concentration. Gayle stayed back in the crease to smack it to leg, got a thick top edge and it almost got lost in the sky. Rohit gets under it and then spills it
touch short of length outside off, tapped to third man for one

misfield by Malinga at fine leg, goes for four! Kohli turned on his back foot to pull the short ball late to fine leg. Malinga went to his right to stop that and looks like he overran it and the ball went past him
back of length outside off, leans towards the ball and pushes straight to point
slower and fuller, well outside off, Gayle chases it away from the body and a thick edge flies over short third man for four
slightly fuller outside off, Gayle doesn't move his feet much and drives on off
outswinging delivery from length outside off, Kohli drives towards cover but gets an inside edge to fine leg
pretty full and swinging into the pads, helped to fine leg with a flick for one
much wider on length outside the off stump, Gayle throws his bat at it and gets another bottom edge
starts with a slower delivery outside the off stump, Gayle pokes and misses it
angling across outside the off stump, Kohli leans into it and drives it to point where Pollard dives and saves a few runs
continues with the short ball, Gayle continues to pull. But he doesn't middle it and Pandya runs to his right at deep midwicket to keep it to one
pulls the short ball again, but gets an inside edge onto the pads
keep bowling short to him and he'll smack it for six! It was around the off stump and he pulled that over wide long on for a clean hit
bangs in the bouncer this time over the batsman, he lets it go for a wide
pretty short outside off again, Gayle leaves again and turns around on his back foot
back of length outside the off stump, Gayle shoulders his big arms
consolatory six for Mumbai as McClenaghan sweeps this one over the midwicket boundary with the spin for six!
flattish down the leg side, he tries to sweep and misses. DK appeals for caught behind and it's turned down, but not given a wide either
lofts the full delivery straight down the ground, he has middled it. Kohli jumps at long off, but it goes just over him
slides the quicker one across the batsman on the off side, he swings and misses
goes down on a knee to slog it on the leg side, gets another edge as the ball turns, and this one doesn't go far. DK runs towards the short cover region and takes it easily
length delivery outside the off stump, Suchith comes down and swings his bat. It goes high but clears cover and they come back for two
in the block hole outside off now, Suchith swings his bat and the thick outside edge runs down quickly to third man for one
accurate yorker on the leg stump, Simmons gets another edge - this one down to fine leg for one
short and wide outside off, Suchith opens up and cuts that over point from the middle of the bat
swinging yorker on middle, driven firmly to cover for one
that's not from the top edge, he has simply lofted the length ball down the ground to long on for an easy peasy catch
falls safe! Bhajji miscued that with a thick edge that went very high and down the ground. Chahal ran backwards, Mandeep ran in; Chahal got a hand to it but wasn't under it to catch it
the low full toss on middle stump is steered down to long on for one
full and closer to the stumps, lofted down the ground towards AB at long off, falls well short of him
comes down and makes some room, Harshal delivers a yorker and Simmons misses on the leg side
slams it down the ground in the air, it would have easily gone for four but AB runs to his left and goes low in front to get his hands under it in no time. Excellent catch and Rayudu goes
119.4kph, he opens up again, gets a fullish delivery and slog-sweeps it over the midwicket boundary from the middle of the bat for six!
Rayudu opens up to heave, Harshal pitches it well outside off for a wide
almost in the block hole on middle stump, inside edge bounces over the bowler for one
tries the yorker, and the low full toss is steered to the leg side for one
slower bouncer cutting in towards Simmons, he charges down with some room, pulls it over his head and gets an edge to the fine leg boundary for four
tries to heave on the leg side, but there's hardly any pace on it and the ball gets the toe end of the bat
in the block hole on the off stump, he blocks it on the off side
touch closer to the stumps now, Simmons clears his front foot and slams it straight over Kohli's head at long-on for six
short of length ball with enough room, it was slower too, and he cuts it late enough to beat backward point for four
he sends it high and flying down the ground, AB is getting ready at the long-off boundary, he jumps to catch the ball but it's too high and goes over after touching his hand
fullish on the stumps, tucked to the leg side between deep midwicket and square leg for two
gone this time, beaten by the turn! He came down the track to slam it again, but the length delivery turned away from him as he swung his bat and DK did the rest before Pandya could look back
short and flat, Pandya stays back and swings his bat to slam that over the long-on boundary for a clean six
he comes down too, Chahal pitches it slower and it's tucked to the leg side for one
he comes down, gets a low full toss and edges it to the leg side for one
gets an inside edge on the pads in an attempt to pull it to leg
slower one on the pads, flicked away to deep midwicket for one
Simmons mistimes the pull off the short ball and it falls well short of long on
comes down the track to tonk the ball on the leg side but it angles across outside the off stump

leading edge caught at deep cover nicely by Starc! Length delivery around the off stump from Aravind, Pollard tried another heave on the leg side and only got a thick and high leading edge. Starc had enough time to get under it in the deep
full on leg stump, and Pollard flicks it off the pads with some power just wide of long on for four. The fielder hardly had any time to react
full toss on the off side and it's heaved to deep midwicket with a big swing for one
he comes down the track, Wiese pitches it wide and Pollard swings outside off and misses
slightly closer to the stumps, swatted on the leg side for one
slower ball outside the off stump, Simmons makes room and get too far away from the ball to connect
slightly short and angled in, mistimes the pull to deep midwicket
slower ball outside the off stump, Simmons swishes at it to find deep point
138kmh, short ball now, Pollard gets on top of it and bludgeons it wide of the long-on fielder with a pull for four
shuffles across towards off stump, Starc still aims for middle stump and Simmons flicks it in the air towards deep midwicket
helps the length delivery on off stump towards point for one
in the block hole outside off with the angle, tries to steer it fine but misses
too full, too straight and Pollard simply stands tall and drives that straight down the ground over mid-off for four
fullish on the stumps, clipped off the back foot to deep square leg for two quick runs
it's Simmons' turn now - he also dances down the pitch to muscle that full delivery absolutely straight down the ground, towards the sight screen, high and far. Six runs
comes down the pitch again, tries to heave on leg and sends it along the ground to long on
googly turning into the batsman, helped to the leg side for one
goes back and across now, clipped to the leg side for one with an inner edge
that's a monster hit! Charged down the ground to not let it turn, took it on the full on middle stump, and tonked it straight down the ground, very very high for anoter massive six
flat delivery on middle stump, Simmons pushes it down to long off with the turn
too short, launched too high, gone too far! Pollard made room by moving to the off side, picked the short ball and hammered that with a pull to the midwicket boundary for a big six!
bouncer on the stumps, Simmons makes room and slaps it down to long on
gets a fuller one now and flicks it in the air to fine leg for one
slow offcutter coming in, Pollard goes back for the short ball and pulls that awkwardly, as he's surprised by the lack of pace, but he beats deep backward square leg for four
clears his front foot and swats the short ball to long on for one
116.5kmh, angled into the pads, it deflects away behind square on the leg side for a leg bye
yorker outside off, there's nobody in the deep and Simmons opens the face of the bat so late that he beats short third man and steers the ball along the ground for four
back of length and angled in, he helps it to the square leg region with soft hands so that they can come back for the second quickly
in the block hole on middle stump, Pollard defends and guides it to short third man for a quick single
widish outside off now, he gets enough room and lofts the ball straight over mid off for four more. Just had to clear that one fielder
down the leg side further and Pollard guides that by closing the face of the bat late enough to beat short fine leg for four
angled into the batsman from wide of the crease, Pollard tucks it behind square on the leg side for two
slower delivery cutting into the batsman, he inside-edges it to short fine leg
takes a step down and swat-pulls the short ball, while taking his eyes off it, to deep square leg
slightly back of length on the off stump, solid defence from Pollard
fuller on middle stump, tucked away with a flick down to fine leg for one
angled in towards the batsman, helped towards square leg for one
slower offcutter on length on the off side, Rohit takes a step down and holes out to long on. He didn't pick the slower one, it seems, and lofted it straight down Mandeep's throat in the deep
angled in towards middle and leg, pushed wide of long on the in the gap and Simmons makes it back for the second
flatter and shorter on middle and leg, Rohit comes down and pushes it back to the bowler
on the off stump now, Rohit taps it towards backward point
turning to middle from leg, turned to midwicket for one more
outside off now, pushed to cover off the front foot
slightly slow towards middle and leg, tucked to the leg side for one
drives that elegantly to cover, the fielder has a shy at non-striker's end. Not a direct hit, overthrow conceded
too short for Rohit, he doesn't have to move much to pull that over the midwicket boundary for a clean six!
slower length delivery on the off side, Rohit tries to cut but misses
more towards the off stump now, worked down to long on for one
full delivery on the off side, with enough room, but he doesn't swing his arms and decides to run it fine down the off side with a late cut for four
length delivery on the off stump, worked to the leg side for one
slow and low on middle and leg, flicked towards deep midwicket for one
flicks the full toss on the off stump to deep square leg for one
charges down to swat-pull the short ball just wide and over mid on, the fielder - Aravind - puts in a tough chase and saves two
dances down this time to take it on the full, and he tonks it with a flick over the midwicket boundary for a six
the batsman makes room, Harshal chases him with a yorker on the leg side and Simmons digs it out to cover
full on off stump, mistimes the drive down to mid on
length and outside off, Rohit goes low and sweeps it behind square leg for four. Crackin' hit, that
fullish and on off, punched to mid-off
good length on off, Rohit steps down the track, looks to smash through the covers, but only manages an inside edge onto the pads
pushed to the leg side off an inner edge
back of a length and swerving away wide outside off, left alone
down the track and flat-batted down the ground
back of a length and outside off, chopped to point

banged in short and outside off, Simmons jumps up, punches it to the covers and sets off. The fielder (Kohli) moves to his left swoops down on the ball and puts in an accurate throw to DK, who whips the bails off. Parthiv's bat got jammed into the ground and he was caught short! Kohli is pumped, super-pumped
Simmons steps away, manufactures his own width and cuts it to point
length on off, Parthiv makes a trip down the track, throws his bat at it. Drags it backward of square leg off an inner edge
back of a length, Simmons backs away and hacks it. The ball lands in front of Wiese at mid-on. Not middled at all
shortish and outside off, the bowler saw Parthiv step out. Dabbed quietly behind point for one
picked away off the pads behind square on the leg side
Starc hunts for another yorker, ends up bowling a full toss. Parthiv steps away, frees his arms and carves it in the gap at the covers. 23 runs off Starc's first two overs
Starc retorts with a yorker on a fourth-stump line, jabbed in front of point
sliding into the pads again, right in the flicking radar of Parthiv. Put away wide of short fine leg
on the pads, Parthiv looks to flick it away, gets an inner edge onto the pads, the ball rolls in front of mid-on
very full and tails in a bit at 144ks, Parthiv drills a drive between the non-striker and the bowler. The bat twisted in Parthiv's hand, had enough legs to reach the long-on boundary, though
shortish and outside off, Parthiv camps back, just about clears midwicket with a not-so-timed pull
back of a length, hint of width on offer. Simmons wants to slap it away off the back foot but mis-hits it to the covers
back of a length and on middle, the bowler shortened his length. Simmons nips down the track, checks his push and plays it towards the covers
on a length and veering onto the pads, tucked to deep square leg
length on middle and leg, bunted just wide of mid-on for one
on a length and angling away outside off at a slowy pace, tapped to point
slides this one down leg, much like how Starc started off. The ball brushes the thigh en route to DK
pitched up and outside off with some away movement, worked to square leg off another inner edge. Chahal fumbles and concedes a single
hurled in very full and outside off, not a yorker. Wrestled away towards backward point with an open face
Starc errs too full and straight. Simmons twirls his wrists and flicks it to the right of mid-on
on a length and outside off, skiddy ball. Pushed in front of the covers for one
back of a length and swerves in on middle, this time to the right hander. Simmons squirts it behind square on the leg side off an inner edge
swings in a bit on the pads, but the length is too full. Parthiv whips it to long leg and trots off to the other end
Starc drifts his first ball down leg, Parthiv can't connect with the glance. Wide called
